bounded_relation.definition: x,y are a legal pair; Omega(U+x+y)=0; and the follower has either zero legal moves or exactly two mutually legal moves
bounded_relation.format: fixed first-order incidence/cardinality formula; no matching, Grundy value, minimax query, or recursive survivor membership
bounded_relation.name: R_small(U; x,y)
bounded_relation.rank_one_shell: Shell_small(U) iff every legal x has a legal y with R_small(U;x,y)
bounded_relation.soundness: the zero-move follower is terminal P; the two-move follower is P by replying with the other move

full_outer_correspondence.selection: retain all replies lexicographically minimizing (small-shell rank, coverage deficiency)
